- Trial: 5-day window from max(created_at, TRIAL_RESET_DATE=2025-12-16)

## Phase 4: Meditation Timer
Goal: Users can run a full Kriya meditation session with smooth native breathing animation at 60fps.

Key requirements:
- Reanimated 3 (~3.17.4 pinned) breathing orb animation — inhale/hold/exhale/post-hold
- Kriya ratios: inhale 6s, hold 3s, exhale 6s, post-hold 3s (verify from existing meditation-session screen)
- Phase label (Inhale/Hold/Exhale) synced to animation — no drift
- expo-keep-awake to prevent screen lock during session
- Firebase Analytics event on session completion
- 60fps on mid-range Android (worklet-based, no JS thread blocking)
- Existing meditation-session screen: /Users/satori/Documents/Development/Kriyaverse/app/meditation-session/[packId]/[subKriyaId].tsx

## What to research:
1. Read the existing meditation-session screen fully

3. Reanimated 3 withTiming/withSequence/withRepeat for breathing cycle
4. useSharedValue + useAnimatedStyle for the orb scale/opacity
5. useAnimatedReaction for syncing phase label to animation progress (no drift)
6. expo-keep-awake API (activateKeepAwakeAsync / deactivateKeepAwakeAsync)
7. expo-firebase-analytics or @react-native-firebase/analytics for session_complete event
8. Check if newArchEnabled:false affects Reanimated 3 worklet execution
